description: This file implements GPIO driver functions for Atmel SAM microcontrollers within the Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, interrupt handling, and callback management.

methods.name: gpio_sam_port_configure
methods.description: Configures GPIO port pins with specified mask and flags, setting drive mode, pull-up/down, debounce, and direction.

methods.name: gpio_sam_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads raw input state of GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_sam_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO port pins to specified values.

methods.name: gpio_sam_port_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for GPIO port pins.

methods.name: gpio_sam_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt for a single GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_sam_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for GPIO, fires registered callbacks.

methods.name: gpio_sam_init
methods.description: Initializes the GPIO device, enabling clock and setting up configuration.
